title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Psychological Well-Being Using Behavioral, Cognitive, and Digital Interaction Patterns
summary: Publisher full abstract: cross-sectional sample of 607 university students, 17 behavioral/cognitive/digital predictors; nested 5-fold CV and independent 20% test set, SVR test R²=.4216; growth mindset was top permutation-importance feature. This is a measured social/behavioral association/prediction, not causal evidence.
